exact_result: Intrinsic orbit-root order isomorphisms on actual H, CPSH and PSH for all Reeb fields, with normalized quotient cocycles and uniform sign-sensitive bounds; actual mixed-MA and energy continuity for locally uniformly convergent CPSH sequences with varying Reeb fields; signed finite-type norm/primary-list representation and uniform signed cutoff estimates; exact signed projective test-configuration cumulative-mean factor. No general finite-energy comparison or uniform affine-cone energy differentiation is proved.
concrete_gaps: A presentation-independent signed norm representation of the genuine affine-cone CLD energy, with all weighted quotient, Veronese, radial and calibrated finite-degree factors. Only local-uniform CPSH analytic continuity, not unbounded finite-energy continuity, has been proved.
A Reeb-uniform bound for normalized genuine energy, preservation of E1 through decreasing nets, and continuity in the actual strong finite-energy topology.
Uniform mixed-integrability and tails for moving Monge-Ampere measures; fixed-measure pointwise bounds do not supply these.

A noncircular justified envelope application on singular normal projective Reeb quotients, including the growth convention, weak/global PSH dependency chain, countability removal and residual torus/carrier checks.
The genuine extended/enveloped-energy construction and two-sign uniform differentiation in a proved dense direction class, followed by actual uniform approximation of continuous directions.
Continuity of the intrinsic comparison in Wu's quasi-monomial PSH topology is not asserted; the proved PSH continuity is for pointwise convergence on all analytic points.
